flow-definition.description: Webhook-driven deployment skeleton for don-t-land/dev to dontland. Uses Jenkins credentials, password-only SSH, immutable releases, and optional deploy verification scripts.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: VERIFY_ONLY
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Verify Jenkins-to-dontland SSH authentication without checking out or deploying source.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: ENABLE_LINGER
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: One-time: enable the dontland user systemd manager at boot via sudo.
